card: Rebindable controls: one binding table drives input, remap screen and all hints
guards: existing settings.test.ts cases (6) unchanged - defaultSettings gains bindings, version stays 1
bindings.test 'default hint copy matches today's strings' pins settings/listen copy (red before only because the module did not exist)
deviations_from_card: No separate coverLeft/coverRight actions: they would duplicate moveLeft/moveRight's default KeyA/KeyD, so the listen screen reads moveLeft/moveRight and slot1-3 for cover (case 8 asks exactly that) plus its own listenHold. Uniqueness is per screen: two actions may share a key only if no screen reads both (roll and listenHold both default to Space). Case 8 is tested through bindings.listenKey, the pure handler listen.ts's onKey now calls (listen.ts imports Pixi). controlsReducer lives in screens/controls.ts and is tested from bindings.test.ts. Sprint bound to one side of a modifier answers both sides (ShiftLeft default keeps ShiftRight working). Reserved list also includes NumpadEnter, Comma (bout reader) and KeyB (lab-mode builds); the lab keys come from lab-mode.ts labKey. router.ts gained the 'controls' overlay spec and ScreenHost.controls; router.test.ts fake host and overlay set extended to match. preventDefault keeps today's Space/ArrowUp/ArrowDown always and adds any bound scroll/quick-find key (arrows, PageUp/Down, Home, End, Slash, Quote, Backspace); letters stay un-prevented as today. Settings screen gets a 'Rebind keys' button (836,262) in its control panel; menu/pause copy moved to bindings.ts as fixed menuHint/pauseHint.
notes: Visible change by design: the in-bout keyboard hint reads '1-5 spells' for five-slot Fire/Air (was '1-4' for every school); Water stays '1-4', pad hint unchanged. Default table gives identical InputFrames (case 1), so goldens/vectors untouched. First two gate runs were red only in sibling core-census in-flight files (census-kit.test.ts, then report-counters.ts parse error); third run green after their commit 1596dd6: 835 vitest, node tests and check:design pass. Controls screen not exercised in a browser (no smoke run per repo law); coordinator may want smoke:u3 to visit settings > Rebind keys.
